note: AI-hardware thesis gauge. Every input is a MARKET PROXY (relative strength, credit, rates, breadth), standardized against its own trailing 252 sessions and sign-aligned so + = healthy for the thesis. Hard-data events (capex guides, memory contract prices) are not read here; see event_inputs. The quadrant is a description of the tape, not a forecast; see evidence.

method.z: each input vs its own trailing 252 sessions (>= 126), sign-aligned so + = healthy, clipped at +/-3
method.dial: plain mean of the available input z scores; >= 3 needed
method.band: neutral band |dial| < 0.25: a neutral dial puts the day on an edge (A/B, B/C, C/D, A/D) or the center

quadrants.B: demand up, financing tightening (capital disciplines growth)
quadrants.neutral: at least one dial inside the neutral band

method.stale: an input whose leg stopped printing (regime._series_stale, past the 5-session cutoff) scores nothing; a basket is stale when over half its members are

evidence.verdict: states, not forecasts: no quadrant label shows a forward SMH edge on this history (edge needs >= 20 episodes and a 63-session block-bootstrap 90% interval excluding 0)

method.outcome: forward 21d / 63d SMH log return from each labelled day (and SMH minus SPY)
method.episode: consecutive sessions with the same quadrant label = one episode
method.bootstrap: 1000 reps, seed 22, moving 63-session blocks of the axis; interval on median(label) - median(all labelled days)

notes: Labels are STATES, not forecasts. Every number here describes what followed them on this short history; none is a prediction.
Overlap: consecutive days share almost all of their forward window, so days overstate the sample; episodes are the honest unit.

The history is the prices.db backfill (about two years, and less for inputs whose tickers were added later), a single cycle in which semis mostly rose. Survivorship: the baskets and the breadth list were chosen in 2026 for what the names became.
